shot.name: light-path
shot.prompt: Photoreal cinematic miniature world, tactile ivory origami paper boat with one crisp triangular sail and sharply folded hull, no writing on the paper. Warm amber practical light against deep petrol-blue shadows, natural film contrast, 35mm commercial cinematography. The same single small ivory paper boat is the only hero object. A dark ocean becomes calm as a narrow golden path of reflected sunlight opens across the waves. A small ivory origami sailboat with crisp triangular sail floats steadily toward the warm amber horizon. The camera slowly rises behind the boat revealing the luminous path and immense quiet sea. Emotional relief, tactile paper and realistic water, restrained cinematic atmosphere. One uninterrupted five-second shot.
